candidate_workaround: Treat a truncated acknowledgement as unresolved until the exact target file is inspected, compiled, and executed.

recurrence_guard: After a truncated patch response, verify the exact file path and syntax before any execution or credit.

title: Verify exact file state after truncated patch acknowledgement
trigger_preconditions: A patch response is truncated before its completion status is attributable.
